title: Troubleshooters: Car warranty company Endurance Warranty faces class action lawsuit
summary: A news report on a class-action lawsuit alleging Endurance Warranty denies claims to maximize profit, cold-calls customers, and uses arbitration clauses against them.

assertions.quote: the more claims endurance denies, the more money it makes

verdicts.note: A structural incentive inherent to any fixed-premium claims business, cited directly by plaintiffs' counsel.

assertions.quote: agreed not to cold call people in that state to sell its vehicle service contracts

verdicts.note: FTC and FCC data document this as one of the most common robocall scams, and legitimate warranty companies rarely cold-call.
FTC confirms warranty-expiration telemarketing/mail offers using names like "Motor Vehicle Notification" are scams: "They probably aren't working with your vehicle dealer or manufacturer."

assertions.quote: the contracts require these customers go through arbitration

verdicts.note: A documented contract term cited in the reported lawsuit.
